name: Pylon
one_liner: Pylon is a B2B customer support/helpdesk platform (unified Slack/Teams/email/chat ticketing) with a documented REST API for issues, contacts, messages, and knowledge base data.

evidence.quote: Token must follow Bearer authorization scheme: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6750#section-2.1.
Generate an API token in the Pylon dashboard.
API access and custom dashboards for exporting data and building tailored reports.
The Pylon REST API is a bearer-authenticated interface at https://api.usepylon.com, spanning 22 documented resource groups.

notes: Pylon exposes a documented REST API (api.usepylon.com) authenticated via Bearer token (API token generated by an admin in the Pylon dashboard). API access is gated to the Professional tier and above (paid plan; no free tier confirmed) — Starter tier doc did not list API access. No official vendor-published MCP server was found; multiple community MCP servers exist (JustinBeckwith/pylon-mcp is the most-starred), and Composio wraps one of these community servers rather than an official one, so mcp.status is community, not official, despite the precomputed hint labeling it as wrapping "official" MCP. Pricing page (usepylon.com/pricing) rendered as a JS-driven demo-booking form and did not yield fetchable plan text directly, so the paid-tier claim relies on a third-party summary (featurebase.app) rather than the vendor page itself — confidence lowered accordingly. api_breadth marked medium based on a third-party count of ~22 resource groups (dozens of endpoints), not a directly fetched vendor endpoint count.
